clauses.name: Transportation
clauses.text: Airlines and scheduled or non-scheduled charters/jets/air taxi operators.

clauses.name: Charities / Non-Profit
clauses.text: Collecting donations as a charity or non-profit organization.

clauses.name: High Value Items
clauses.text: Operating as a dealer in jewels, precious metals and stones.

clauses.name: Payment Facilitator
clauses.text: Providing payment services which would fall under the definition of a money service business or an electronic money institution. Services would also include the sale of stored value cards and escrow services.

clauses.name: Investments
clauses.text: Buying, selling, or brokering stocks, bonds, securities, options, figures, commodities, contracts for difference/forex, mutual funds or an investment interest in any entity or property.

clauses.name: Gambling, Gaming, Prize Draws and Contests
clauses.text: Activities involving gambling, gaming and/or any other activity with an entry fee and a prize, including, but not limited to property/real estate prizes, casino games, sports betting, horse or greyhound racing, fantasy sports, lottery tickets, other ventures that facilitate gambling, games of skill (whether or not legally defined as gambling) and sweepstakes, if the operator and customers are located exclusively in jurisdictions where such activities are permitted by law.

clauses.name: Cryptocurrency
clauses.text: Any digital representation of value that can be digitally traded, transferred, or used for payment, including, but not limited to, crypto currencies, virtual in-game currencies, or non-fungible tokens.

clauses.name: Prescription Items
clauses.text: The sale of any product(s) requiring a prescription or prescription dispensing services.

clauses.name: Telemedicine Services
clauses.text: Providing medical services and consultations in a remote fashion.

clauses.name: Mature Audience Content
clauses.text: Any adult content delivered digitally including video on demand (VOD) and web-cam activities. PayPal may be restricted from processing payments in certain jurisdictions for adult DVD's, magazines and other adult themed products or services.

clauses.name: Online Dating
clauses.text: Any dating services that enable individuals to find and introduce themselves to new people with the goal of developing a personal or romantic relationship.

clauses.name: Live Streaming/Broadcasting
clauses.text: Any activities in which people transmit video, voice or text content in a live environment with the potential of user interaction.

clauses.name: File-Sharing
clauses.text: Providing file sharing services including cyberlockers and similar remote digital file sharing services where uploaded content is accessible to the public or the service pays uploaders for content.

clauses.name: Alcohol
clauses.text: Selling alcoholic beverages.

clauses.name: Tobacco
clauses.text: Non-cigarette tobacco products, e-cigarettes, cigars

clauses.name: Medical Items or Services
clauses.text: All items classified as medical devices, and all services or treatment provided by a person or organization holding itself out as a provider of health-care services, including, but not limited to, all health-care services for which government licensure is required in the provider's jurisdiction or in the jurisdiction where services are being provided. This category includes "Medical Tourism" involving medical services to be provided to a patient outside of that patient's home country.

clauses.name: Multilevel Marketing and Direct Selling Organizations
clauses.text: Direct Sales Organizations ("DSOs") and the Multi-Level Marketing ("MLMs") are distribution and marketing models in which products or services are sold via a network of independent distributors or representatives. DSO and MLM models rely on personal sales and frequently require the independent distributors to recruit new distributors in order to advance within the organization or gain incentive compensation.

clauses.name: Marketplaces
clauses.text: A marketplace is an e-commerce solution where third-party sellers can sell their products or services to customers.
